name: Voxel-based Ray Tracing for GI and Specular Reflections
definition: A voxel-based ray tracing system using DDA traversal through a 128³ block-occupancy grid to provide global illumination (GI) and specular reflection fallbacks.
summary: Voxel-based Ray Tracing uses 3D-DDA on a voxel grid to sample Light Propagation Volumes for global illumination and specular reflection fallbacks, differing from regular grid traversal by computing indirect lighting rather than volumetric density.
